results.title: Momentum Trading: Strategies, Signals & How It Works in ...
results.snippet: Momentum trading is the practice of buying assets that have been rising and selling assets that have been falling, based on the empirical observation that recent performance tends to persist. Assets that have performed well over the past several months tend to keep performing well, and assets that have performed poorly tend to keep performing poorly. This pattern - one of the most studied in financial economics - has been documented across equities, bonds, commodities, and currencies. [...] The classic implementation checks whether the trailing 12-month return is positive or negative. If positive, hold a long position. If negative, hold a short position or move to cash. This simple rule has produced positive risk-adjusted returns across commodities, equity indices, bonds, and currencies over many decades.
